items.title: 8.14 Darja hararat ki tabdeeli ka asar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.14, printed pages 181-182.

blocks.text: Le Chatelier ka usool darja hararat badalne par reaction ki simt ka andaza deta hai, aur darja hararat wahid aamil hai jo equilibrium constant ki qeemat bhi badalta hai. Exothermic reaction ke liye darja hararat mein izafa (hararat dena) reverse reaction ko tarjeeh deta hai aur kami forward ko. 2SO2(g) + O2(g) se 2SO3(g), delta H = -198 kJ, ke liye darja hararat barhana reaction ko daen se baen shift karta hai: SO3 ghatta, SO2 aur O2 barhte, aur equilibrium constant ghatta hai; darja hararat ghatana forward reaction aur SO3 ke banne ko tarjeeh deta hai, jo kam darja hararat par tarjeeh pata hai. Is reaction ka Kc 1000 K par 2.8 x 10^2 magar 298 K par 1 x 10^26 hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab SO3 wali misal mein pehle sahi kehti hai ke darja hararat barhane se reaction baen (left) shift hota hai. Phir agle paragraph mein likhti hai 'an increase in temperature will shift the reaction from left to right' aur SO3 aur Kc barhte hain. Yahan 'increase' ki jagah 'decrease' hona chahiye: darja hararat ghatane se reaction daen shift hota hai, SO3 barhta hai aur Kc barhta hai. Kc ki qeematein (298 K par 1 x 10^26, 1000 K par 2.8 x 10^2) isi ki tasdeeq karti hain.

Endothermic reaction ke liye darja hararat mein izafa forward reaction ko tarjeeh deta hai aur kami reverse ko. N2O4(g) se 2NO2(g), delta H = +57.2 kJ, ke liye darja hararat barhana reaction ko baen se daen shift karta hai: N2O4 ghatta, NO2 barhta aur Kc barhta hai; darja hararat ghatana use daen se baen shift karta aur reactant ko tarjeeh deta hai. Is reaction ka Kc 273 K par 7.7 x 10^-5 aur 373 K par 0.4 hai.

blocks.prompt: 2H2O(g) se 2H2(g) + O2(g), ek endothermic reaction, ke liye kaun si tabdeeli pani ki equilibrium miqdar ghatati hai: oxygen shamil karna, catalyst shamil karna, hajm ghatana, ya mustaqil dabao par darja hararat barhana?
blocks.explanation: Darja hararat barhana: forward, endothermic simt ko tarjeeh milti hai, to pani mazeed toot-ta hai. Oxygen shamil karna equilibrium ko wapas pani ki taraf dhakelta hai; hajm ghatana kam gas moles wali taraf, pani, ko tarjeeh deta hai; catalyst raftar ke siwa kuch nahi badalta.

items: Sirf darja hararat Kc badalta hai. Exothermic (SO3 banna, -198 kJ): garam karna baen shift karta aur Kc ghatata hai (298 K par 10^26 se 1000 K par 2.8 x 10^2). Endothermic (N2O4 tootna, +57.2 kJ): garam karna daen shift karta aur Kc barhata hai (273 K par 7.7 x 10^-5 se 373 K par 0.4).
